# Design checks

What `npm run design:check` enforces, by rule in [the design rules](rules.md). Each failure
prints what is wrong, the fix and the rule. Call sites awaiting a fix are listed in
`web/scripts/design-rules-exemptions.json` and `web/scripts/composition-allowlist.json`,
which only shrink.

## Rules in the rulebook that a check helps enforce

| Rule | Says | Checked by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | The design rules beat every other source, so the rulebook must exist and AGENTS.md must link it. | design-rules.mjs: the rulebook exists and AGENTS.md links it |
| R2 | Features and core compose the shared-ui primitives and write no styles of their own. | composition-freeze.mjs: no owned styles or raw `<details>` outside its shrinking allowlist; design lint: no primitive's internal `mn-*__*` class in a feature template; stylelint: no component styles a .mn-* selector |
| R5 | A rule changes only when the owner says so; the rulebook and AGENTS.md stay within their line budgets. | design-rules.mjs: every rule a check cites is listed; every checked rule is a `**Rn.**` rule in the rulebook; AGENTS.md at most 90 lines and the rulebook at most 160 |
| R20 | Each kind of input has exactly one control, and a native `<select>` is never used. | design lint: no `<select>` in a feature or core template |
| R28 | Each overlay kind has one mechanism, so no second dropdown, popover or sheet is added. | composition-freeze.mjs: no native [popover], and no PopoverService outside the reader |
| R34 | Type has eight roles, each a token. | stylelint: font-size and font-weight take a token |
| R37 | One state layer shows hover and press, and hover shows only under a mouse. | stylelint: every :hover selector carries the mouse guard |
| R54 | Interface strings use no em dash, exclamation mark, "&" or three dots. | design lint: template text in features and core holds none of them |

## Rules that live only in their check

These left the rulebook because a check enforces them completely. The failure message
says the fix.

| Rule | Says | Checked by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R6 | The design checks run in npm test, and their exemption lists only shrink. | design-rules.mjs: no eslint-disable or stylelint-disable comment in features or core, exemptions only shrink, every cited rule is listed here; design-checks-doc.mjs --check: this page is current |
| R15 | A settings row never holds a button, a field, a pill or a boxed select; the row is the control. | design lint: no button, mnButton, input, textarea, select, mn-field, mn-search-field, mn-secret-field, mn-range-field or mn-status-pill inside mn-settings-row |
| R35 | Icons have three sizes, by role: inline, control and feature. | design-rules.mjs: an mn-icon size is one of ICON_SIZES |
| R38 | Radii are roles, and a shape uses its role's token. | stylelint: border-radius takes a token |
| R39 | No literal colour is written outside _tokens.scss; sizes, radii, shadows and durations are tokens or belong to the one primitive that owns them. | design-rules.mjs: no colour literal outside _tokens.scss; stylelint: colours, backgrounds, borders and shadows take a token, and no hex colour in a component |
| R40 | A press is a colour change and nothing else. | design-rules.mjs: no scale in a :active rule or the press mixin |
| R44 | Motion lives only in _motion.scss, and `transition: all` is never used. | design-rules.mjs: no `transition: all`; stylelint: no hand-written transition, animation or @keyframes outside _motion.scss |
| R47 | The Android bridge's colours match the colour tokens in both themes. | android-colours.mjs: values/colors.xml and values-night/colors.xml match the light and dark palettes of _tokens.scss |
| R52 | A confirmation's confirm button repeats the verb of its question, never OK, Yes, Continue or Really. | design lint: a confirmLabel does not start with OK, Yes, Continue or Really |

## Retired

These numbers are not reused. Another rule, a primitive or a test covers each one now.

| Rule | Said | Now covered by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R11 | Show state; do not narrate it. | R48 (cut first) |
| R13 | A row is a label, an optional secondary line and one trailing end, drawn by the primitive. | the `mn-settings-row` primitive and its doc comment |
| R17 | Status leads a row's secondary line, and a result replaces it. | R16 |
| R24 | A dropdown hangs from its row at the card's width and never leaves the screen. | the `mn-select` dropdown primitive and e2e/dropdown.spec.ts |
| R25 | A searched list is never a dropdown; it is the picker. | R23 and the model picker primitive |
| R27 | Back, Escape and a press outside close the top overlay; focus returns to the opener. | the overlay primitives and their e2e tests |
| R32 | Standing prose only where money, network or data loss is at stake. | R51 |
| R33 | A field's error is one danger line under it, replacing its hint. | the `mn-field` primitive |
| R36 | Spacing comes only from the layout tokens. | R2 (features write no styles) and the token rules in stylelint |
| R41 | Overlays fade with a little travel; none changes size. | the named motions in `_motion.scss` (R44) |
| R46 | The lavender is not a tone. | R45 (highlight is not a tone) |
